## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Security

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] Full test suite passed, or failures are explained
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples updated
- [ ] No credentials, private documents, local databases, or private evaluation labels included
- [ ] Performance or quality claims have reproducible evidence

## Notes for reviewers

List relevant risks, limitations, screenshots, or follow-up work.
